fact: Rwanda and Tanzania are advancing a cross-border Instant Payment System proof of concept, with a technical mission in Kigali under the EU-EAC DEEP Programme working toward a joint roadmap, per techreviewafrica.

fact: Tanzanian and Rwandan experts met in Zanzibar on 7 to 11 July 2026 to advance an EAC pilot proof of concept linking Tanzania's TIPS and Rwanda's RSwitch for instant cross-border payments, per an EAC statement of 10 July 2026.
